title: Detailed key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- key bow (ring handle) -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='50' r='18' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='50' r='11' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='50' r='11' fill='#8C6510' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='50' r='7' fill='#FFE79A'/>
  <!-- bow decorative dots -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#FFF2C4'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#FFF2C4'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#FFF2C4'/>
  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='44' y='45' width='46' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFC93C'/>
  <rect x='44' y='45' width='46' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFE79A'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='72' y='55' width='6' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#FFC93C'/>
  <rect x='72' y='55' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE79A'/>
  <rect x='82' y='55' width='6' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#FFC93C'/>
  <rect x='82' y='55' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE79A'/>
  <!-- shaft tip -->
  <rect x='86' y='45' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFC93C'/>
  <rect x='86' y='45' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- highlight on shaft -->
  <rect x='48' y='47' width='30' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFF7D6'/>
  <!-- shine on bow -->
  <path d='M18 42 Q22 38 26 40' stroke='#FFF7D6' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
